items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: His father was a contractor, building contractor, named Pittman.

ctx.x: This is the grandson of Booker T. Washington. In fact, he was named after his grandfather, Booker Taliaferro Pittman, and Mr. Pittman, who his father was, who married Portia Pittman, which was Booker T. Washington's oldest daughter, in fact, Booker and me were sort of in the crib together, because the families -- my family and his family was very tight.
His father was a contractor, building contractor, named Pittman. And he married Portia. Portia -- Portia was Booker T. Washington's oldest daughter, and she taught music

in the public high school. They named the school after Booker T. Washington. I went to Booker T. Washington High School in Dallas, Texas. And she was the music teacher. She taught voice, but she spoke seven languages fluently, because she had studied all over the world, Berlin Conservatory of Music, every place she had gone.
